data.value: My message to our very cutie Sir Bill is that he’s really good at teaching (plus he’s handsome!) and has a chill vibe. I can understand his lessons well, and he’s easy to approach whenever we’re having a hard time with our activities. Thank you for being our handsome and cutie instructor this semester, Sir. I hope you’ll be our instructor again next semester. Good luck to us on our journey in the tech field. Yun lang, tapos na! :>
